setting.description: Settings that can be changed at runtime. Changes take effect immediately and are recorded in the audit log. The allowed ranges are fixed by the system, so no value can weaken security.

defaultTimezone.label: Default time zone
defaultTimezone.description: Used to calculate the send times of recurring announcements. Times on screen use each user's own time zone preference (Asia/Taipei for new accounts) and are not affected by this setting.

loginMaxAttempts.label: Failed sign-ins before lockout
loginMaxAttempts.description: The account is locked after this many consecutive wrong passwords.

loginLockoutSeconds.label: Lockout duration
loginLockoutSeconds.description: How long a locked account must wait before trying again.

passwordMinLength.label: Minimum password length
passwordMinLength.description: Required when setting, resetting or changing a password and when registering. Can only be stricter than the system minimum (12).

registrationEnabled.label: Accept registration requests
registrationEnabled.description: When off, the sign-in page hides the registration link and new requests are rejected.

activationTtlHours.label: Activation link lifetime
activationTtlHours.description: How long the activation link for a new account stays valid after it is sent.

passwordResetTtlHours.label: Password reset link lifetime
passwordResetTtlHours.description: How long the password reset link stays valid after it is sent.

personalTokenMaxDays.label: Personal API token maximum lifetime
personalTokenMaxDays.description: How far out a user can set the expiration of a personal API token (platform limit: 90 days).

serviceAccountTokenMaxDays.label: Service account API token maximum lifetime
serviceAccountTokenMaxDays.description: How far out the expiration of a service account's API token can be set (platform limit: 365 days).

uploadMaxSize.label: Maximum file size
uploadMaxSize.description: The largest file that can be uploaded. Cannot exceed the limit set for this deployment.

retentionDays.label: Retention
retentionDays.description: Deleted items stay in the trash for this many days. After that the daily job deletes them permanently and they can no longer be restored.

keepVersions.label: Versions to keep
keepVersions.description: Each item always keeps at least this many of its latest versions, however old.

keepDays.label: Days to keep
keepDays.description: Versions from the last this many days are always kept. Older versions beyond the version count are deleted by the daily job and can no longer be viewed or restored.

notificationRetentionDays.label: Read notification retention
notificationRetentionDays.description: Notifications read more than this many days ago are deleted by the daily job. Unread notifications are not affected.

notificationMaxPerUser.label: Notifications kept per user
notificationMaxPerUser.description: When a user has more than this many notifications, the daily job deletes the oldest ones, read or not.

announcementMaxRecipients.label: Max recipients per announcement
announcementMaxRecipients.description: If an announcement resolves to more recipients than this, that send fails with the reason shown in its history instead of reaching only some people.

announcementDispatchRetentionDays.label: Announcement send history retention
announcementDispatchRetentionDays.description: Finished sends older than this are deleted by the daily job; recipients can no longer open the full text from old notifications.

dataTransferRetentionDays.label: Keep exports and import results for
dataTransferRetentionDays.description: How long exported files and per-row import results are kept after completion (1–30 days). Summaries are kept for 90 days.
